title: Strict henselization at a point with DVR local ring
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] lying over $y\in Y$, and suppose the local ring $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y,\bar x}$ be the strict henselization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], with the canonical ring map $\iota:\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y,\bar x}$ induced by the maps $\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to A_V$ of the affine pointed etale neighbourhoods $(V=\operatorname{Spec}A_V,\bar v)$ factoring through an affine open of $y$. Then $\iota$ is a flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] local homomorphism [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] (hence injective), and $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ is a discrete valuation ring if and only if $\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y,\bar x}$ is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring].
